  At midnight a fishing boat appeared out of the fog, its engine coughing. It was lost, drifting toward the rocks. Its skipper saw the light and steered by it,
  as he had every night since boyhood.

  Marguerite stayed until dawn. She wrote the entry carefully: Lamp lit. One vessel guided. Keeper on duty to the end.

  Then she locked the door and walked down to the boats.
